meta.name: aligned-stem-workflow
meta.description: Incremental audio production with duration alignment handling, per-stem verification, and adaptive extension strategies

copy.tagline: 增量制作音频并自动对齐时长
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按音轨分段制作音频并自动处理时长对齐
copy.tagline_en: Produce audio incrementally with automatic duration alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce audio in segments with automatic duration alignment

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照严格的步骤生成多个音频轨道（stem），每生成一个就立刻验证，如果发现长度不一致会自动对齐，最后导出主文件。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 制作多轨音频，或者需要处理参考文件并生成对齐的音频轨道时触发。

say.text: 检查各轨道的时长，把短的用循环补到目标长度。
say.note: Claude 会自动检测并对齐。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a strict incremental workflow to generate audio stems one by one, verifying each immediately and aligning durations automatically before exporting the master track.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to produce multi-track audio, or to process a reference file and generate aligned stems.

say_en.text: Use 'reference.wav' to generate bass, guitars, and synths stems.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and verify each stem step by step.

say_en.text: Check stem durations and loop-extend the shorter ones to match target length.
